title: Best Garage Removal in Leeds
intro: An old concrete sectional garage, a crumbling brick garage or an asbestos roof you want gone. Below are 3 firms that remove and demolish garages around Leeds, what to check about asbestos first, and what garage removal typically costs.
seo_title: Garage Removal Leeds: 3 Local Demolition Firms (2026)
seo_desc: Garage removal in Leeds: 3 local firms that demolish garages and remove asbestos garage roofs, typical 2026 costs, and what to check before work starts.
h1: Best garage removal in Leeds: 3 local garage demolition firms
checks: Find out whether the roof or panels contain asbestos before you get quotes, as it changes the method and the price.
Ask whether the quote includes removing the concrete base, skips and waste disposal.
Ask for the waste carrier registration and where asbestos waste will be taken.

expert_tip.body: Most work on asbestos cement, which is what many garage roofs are made of, can be done without an HSE licence. How it is done matters more. Breaking or smashing the sheets releases far more fibres, so intact sheets should come off whole and be double wrapped and labelled, not broken into smaller pieces. Ask any firm that quotes how it will take the sheets off and wrap them.

guide.h2: Before you remove a garage: check for asbestos
p: Many garages built in Leeds from the 1950s to the 1980s have corrugated asbestos cement roofs, and some prefab concrete garages have asbestos panels. Get the roof tested before you get quotes. A sample test is quick and cheap compared with the cost of getting it wrong. See asbestos surveys in Leeds.

ul: Removing and wrapping any asbestos sheets
Taking down the roof, walls and doors
Breaking out the concrete base, if you want it gone
Loading waste into skips or lorries and disposing of it legally
Leaving the site level, ready for a lawn, patio or new building

guide.h2: How much does garage removal cost?
p: Checkatrade's 2026 guide puts demolishing a single storey garage at £1,000 to £3,000, averaging £2,000, including labour, skips, waste and removing the base. MyBuilder gives £1,000 to £6,930 depending on whether it is a single, double or triple garage. For asbestos roofs only, MyBuilder gives £350 to £1,295 for a single garage roof. See our garage demolition cost guide.

guide.h2: Do you need permission to demolish a garage?
p: Demolishing a detached garage usually does not need planning permission, but there are exceptions, for example in a conservation area or if the garage is attached to a listed building. Check with Leeds City Council planning before work starts if you are unsure, and tell your neighbours if the work is near a shared boundary.
For a timber shed, greenhouse or small outbuilding, a full demolition firm is often more than you need. See shed and outbuilding removal in Leeds.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to demolish a garage?
faqs.a: Checkatrade's 2026 guide gives £1,000 to £3,000 for a single storey garage, averaging £2,000, including removing the base and waste.

faqs.q: Does an asbestos garage roof need a licensed contractor?
faqs.a: Usually not. HSE says most work on asbestos cement can be done without a licence, but it must be done carefully, keeping sheets whole and wrapping them.

faqs.q: Do I need planning permission to knock down a garage?
faqs.a: Usually not for a detached garage, but check with the council if you are in a conservation area or the garage is attached to a listed building.

faqs.q: How long does garage removal take?
faqs.a: A single garage is often removed in one to two days. Breaking out a thick concrete base can add time.
